title: Grounded or Guessed: An Execution-Verified Reproducibility Study of LLM-Based Semantic Fault Localization (replication package)
description: Code, derived data, run outputs, LLM call log and replayable LLM response cache for a reproducibility study of SemLoc (arXiv:2603.29109): evaluation audit, execution-verified ground truth (SemFault-250-verified), CovGate, an LLM + coverage single-prompt baseline, and robustness on BugsInPy, identifier-renamed programs and five model families. See REPRODUCE.md.

creators.name: IT5440 2KH research group, Hanoi University of Science and Technology
